title: Dexcom G6, XDrip and Tandem t:slim X2
symptom: When using a Sony SmartWatch 3 as collector with xDrip, the watch cannot collect glucose readings from the Dexcom G6 transmitter while a Tandem t:slim X2 pump is also connected to the same transmitter. The pump continues to receive readings, but xDrip on the watch does not. If the phone is used as collector, it works, and if the pump is turned off, the watch works as collector.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One participant (Gonzmdv) speculates that the Sony SmartWatch 3, t:slim X2 pump, and Dexcom receiver all use the same G6 transmitter channel, while the phone uses the other. Another participant (tolot27) contradicts this, stating that the SSW3 uses the phone slot and the t:slim X2 uses the medical device slot, implying they should be able to work simultaneously. No resolution is confirmed.
evidence_quote: As I said when I opened this thread, I have never been able to have the pump and the watch working as collector at the same time, so they must be using the same slot.
